releases.name: duo-editor
releases.description: The Duo editor on iPhone Duo: the claim on the left page and question cards on the right, built on Xcode Cloud and shipped to TestFlight testers.

clusters.title: iPhone Duo editor: one claim, one refutation, on TestFlight
clusters.description: The native slices of CIT-439: the iOS project, the build-time JSON bundle, the Xcode Cloud workflows, the supervisor reading their results, and the SwiftUI app. The Linux-capable pieces run through the agent first; the one-time Xcode Cloud setup needs the maintainer on a Mac. Review findings on the iOS project (CIT-521, CIT-522, CIT-525) are fixed as follow-ups.

done.evidence: PR #342 merged: capture.mjs exits 1 when the page reports a runtime error, and Codex's QA confirmed an injected error gives exit code 1

delegate.ask: Host Edit, Write and Bash are denied by design, so there is nothing to wait for. Start with environment_create to get a container-use environment, then make the Step 1 change to workflow/src/toolbox.ts there: bounded session reinitialization after a 404, no blind replay of side-effect tools, and the session-loss regression test in toolbox.test.ts. Run the tests inside that environment, commit, and reply on this issue with the environment id. Leave Step 2 (the Render deploy filter) and CIT-450 for later.
